name: Silas Dugal
source:
Silas Dugal is a crime lord in Las Vegas, He rose to power by systematically killing his opposition. He keeps a meticulous record of everything he does, and expects precision and professional completion of any job his organization undertakes.

Silas generally keeps a tightly controlled persona. While he is prone to administering judgment that some people view as excessive, Silas knows that's the only way you keep people in line.

He runs several businesses as fronts for his more, creative, endeavors. His most well known location is the Who's Your Daddy? Nightclub, in southern Las Vegas.
